entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Shall we continue this?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm fairly certain any further "negotiating"[n]is pointless.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: That seems to be the case,[n]unfortunately.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But first, I have an idea.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Rather than explain it with words,[n]I'd like you to actually see this new[n]reality with your own eyes.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I know that your friends are already[n]enjoying it, [lName]-kun.
Hand her over.
Let us help her.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...That, I cannot do.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: As I said before, she wishes to live in[n]the reality where she is Kasumi.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: There's no way I can hand her over to[n]you with matters as they currently are.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I already told you that I won't harm her.[n]And I'll swear by it.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Don't worry about her. Go, look at[n]the reality I've created for you all.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Once you've seen the results, I know[n]you'll realize which future is best.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You think we'll just obey your orders?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I apologize, but you really are going[n]through with this—even if it's by force.

entries.speaker: Maruki's Voice
entries.en: We'll meet again one week from today:[n]January 9th.

entries.speaker: Maruki's Voice
entries.en: I genuinely pray that you'll change[n]your mind by then.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Tch... He got away...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We shouldn't chase him too far.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What say we head back for now?
